peers.name: KEYCORP /NEW/
peers.rationale: Super-regional bank with similar commercial/consumer mix and Northeast/Midwest footprint overlap; comparable scale and deposit-funded balance sheet to M&T.

peers.name: CITIZENS FINANCIAL GROUP INC/RI
peers.rationale: Northeast-focused super-regional bank of similar asset size, overlapping commercial banking and consumer footprint with M&T.

peers.name: HUNTINGTON BANCSHARES INC /MD/
peers.rationale: Midwest super-regional bank with comparable commercial lending focus and asset size, useful for multiple comparison despite different regional concentration.

peers.name: FIFTH THIRD BANCORP
peers.rationale: Super-regional bank of similar scale with diversified commercial and consumer banking, though more Midwest/Southeast weighted than M&T's Northeast base.

peers.name: REGIONS FINANCIAL CORP
peers.rationale: Similar-sized regional bank with strong commercial banking franchise; Southeast footprint differs but overall business model and funding profile comparable.

peers.name: ZIONS BANCORPORATION, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION /UT/
peers.rationale: Regional bank with commercial real estate and middle-market lending emphasis similar to M&T, though smaller and Western-focused.

peers.name: PNC FINANCIAL SERVICES GROUP, INC.
peers.rationale: Larger super-regional bank but with significant overlap in Northeast/Mid-Atlantic commercial banking markets, useful as a scale-adjusted comparable.
